name: Woodland
text: Woodland is a city in and the county seat of Yolo County, California, United States. Located approximately 15 miles (24 km) northwest of Sacramento, it is a part of the Sacramento metropolitan area. As of the 2020 census, Woodland had a population of 61,032.

depictions.name: Woodland
depictions.text: Woodland is a neighborhood and world location in Watch Dogs 2, based on the real-life neighborhood of Woodland while also being heavily influenced by the real-life Fruitvale neighborhood.
